info.name: Letta MCP Servers API
info.description:
REST API for Letta, the stateful agents platform. Manage agents, memory blocks, archival passages, sources, custom tools, MCP servers, multi-agent groups, runs, and streaming responses. Available as Letta Cloud (managed) at https://api.letta.com/v1 and as the self-hosted open-source server (Apache-2.0) typically run at http://localhost:8283.

Contact Support:
 Name: Letta
 Email: support@letta.com

request.description:
Execute a specific MCP tool

The request body should contain the tool arguments in the ToolExecuteRequest format.

request.description:
Refresh tools for an MCP server by:
1. Fetching current tools from the MCP server
2. Deleting tools that no longer exist on the server
3. Updating schemas for existing tools
4. Adding new tools from the server

Returns a summary of changes made.
